title: Flag when a Claude Code release makes built-in tool-result clearing reachable
body:
Outcome: a script flags when a Claude Code release makes built-in tool-result clearing reachable (getEnvironmentOverrides implemented, or clear_tool_uses_20250919 edits in recent transcripts), run from SessionStart.
Why: t-mbrjeja found the clearing unreachable in 2.1.319; revisiting needs a trigger without the lead remembering.
Proof: test/claude/cc-clearing-watch.test.ts on captured 2.1.319 snippets, plus one run on the real binary.
Scope: scripts/claude/cc-clearing-watch.ts, .claude/settings.json SessionStart hook, tests and fixtures only.
